tabbedSolutionScope.decision: The live question renderer is a static, type-tailored solution view for every format. Numericals and written answers do not have tabs either. The homepage Step-by-step / Quick answer / Concept labels are an illustrative marketing demo, now explicitly non-interactive and removed from the tab order.

mcqInteractionScope: Published MCQ solution pages present read-only options and the correct answer; they are not quiz controls and expose no option buttons.
phase4Classification: No format may be assumed rich because of tabs: tabs are absent by implementation across all 17 declared formats. The nine declared formats with zero persisted rows are unverified, not thin-by-design. The eight persisted formats require content-depth assessment independent of the homepage demo.
